notes.title: COLONY IS OUT NOW
notes.content:
[h1][b]A Haunting Holiday Release[/b][/h1]

"Colony" is an upcoming first-person horror game developed by Gamer Genesis Studio, scheduled for release on December 25, 2024. 

The game immerses players in a chilling narrative set within a haunted bungalow.

The story begins with a teenage boy playing cricket with his friends near the ominous house.

When a powerful hit sends the ball into the bungalow, he ventures inside to retrieve it, only to encounter a terrifying ghostly presence.

As players navigate the eerie environment, they must solve intricate puzzles to uncover the mysteries of the spirit and ultimately escape its clutches.

The game's atmospheric design, combined with its psychological horror elements, promises to deliver a spine-tingling experience that will keep players on edge throughout their journey.

"Colony" will be available on PC and is expected to launch with a 40% discount, making it an enticing option for horror enthusiasts this holiday season. 

The game supports multiple languages, including English and Tamil, catering to a diverse audience. 

For more information and updates, visit the official Steam page.
